title: Scroll-scrubbed animation clips through mixer.setTime
summary: Three procedural forms (petals on pivots, stacked discs, helix beads) each carry an `AnimationClip` built in code from position, quaternion and scale `KeyframeTrack`s (`2.4 / 2.8 / 3 s`); one paused nine-unit timeline gives each a slot of three: a rail hand-off straddling the boundary (`1` unit, `power2.inOut`), a growth proxy at `+.25` for `1.75` (`sine.inOut`) that becomes `mixer.setTime(proxy × duration)` on a `LoopOnce` action unpaused before every set, a tone at `+1`; ScrollTrigger scrubs it over a `640svh` sticky track (`scrub .8`, `.3` on coarse pointers) with Lenis on the GSAP ticker; frames drawn only after a scroll update or a resize; chapter links with `aria-current` as the DOM mirror; quality tiers set DPR, pixels and segments; settled pose per slot, cut at the boundary, under reduced motion and static; a CSS still without WebGL2
variants: procedural groups with clips built from KeyframeTracks (this, default)
baked clips from a glb: merge each model's tracks into one clip per object and scrub it the same way
masked hand-off: replace the rail slide with a circular discard grown from a DOM element (see gl-material-patch-reveal)
